title: Disneyland Gold Castle Ornament Metal Holiday Christmas Souvenir Disney
descriptionText:
Gold tone metal Disneyland castle ornament
Features the iconic Disneyland castle design with star detailing
Raised embossed artwork on front
Smooth gold tone back with Disney copyright mark
Includes original gold hanging cord
Oval shaped metal ornament
Lightweight and easy to display
Great for Christmas tree, Disney display, or souvenir collection
Approximate measurements
About 3 inches wide
About 2 inches tall
See photos with tape measure for reference
Condition notes
Good overall vintage condition
Light surface wear and minor scuffs consistent with age and handling
No major bends or damage
Please review all photos carefully for exact condition
Perfect for Disney collectors, holiday decor, or park souvenir fans
